The '''''Valediction''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Valediction'' first appeared in Game Update 7.9: ''Legacy Reborn'', released on [[June 2]], [[2026]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260602-0|text=Game Update 7.9 "Legacy Reborn" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

In the mission "Legacy Reborn," if the player is affiliated with the Sith Empire, the ''Valediction'' will take an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] hit by a [[Hidden Chain]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. If the player is affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Endurance (Valor-class)|''Endurance'']] will take the direct hit instead.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
